comparator.sourceNotes: The selected Music and Society pathway closes 60+60+60: 60 EC of foundations, 60 EC of major context/depth/preparation/thesis requirements and 60 EC genuine profiling. The first-listed 30-EC Music and Society package and first-listed 7.5-EC context option are neutral bounded choices made independently of UCR fit. The approved 30-EC profile package and remaining 30 EC of free profiling remain generic. Formal instruction is Dutch plus English.

routeSelection.basis: The generic Musicology target requires one of two 30-EC depth packages and one of two 7.5-EC context courses to instantiate the full major. Music and Society and Art, Culture and Society are each listed first in the adopted 2026-27 EER, so they are selected as neutral official-order tie-breaks. The 60-EC profiling space remains generic because the regulations deliberately leave its approved subject matter to the student. These judgments were fixed before UCR course fit was considered.

exception.reason: The corrected external curriculum is complete at 180 EC. The superseded UCR no-match judgment is preserved in remediation history for the separately excluded UCR reassessment.
